description:
Project: “VPC Terraform modules (alpha)” under Redwood Inference’s Private Deployment Automation initiative.

Goal
- Publish a set of reference Terraform modules that customers (and Redwood Solutions/PS) can use to deploy a standard, secure, and supportable VPC foundation for Redwood Private (VPC) deployments.
- Provide validated defaults (network segmentation, endpoints, DNS, logging, tagging, encryption hooks) and opinionated patterns that reduce deployment variance and support burden.

Scope (alpha)
- Primary target: AWS VPC baseline for Redwood Private deployments.
- Modules: vpc-baseline (VPC + subnets + route tables), security-groups baseline, VPC endpoints (ECR, S3, CloudWatch/Logs, STS as needed), private DNS (Route53), flow logs, optional NAT patterns, and a “redwood-private” wrapper module composing the pieces.
- Validation: CI that runs terraform fmt/validate, static checks (tflint/checkov), and at least one integration plan/apply test in an ephemeral account.
- Compatibility: module versioning, upgrade notes, and clear input/output contracts for Private installer integration.
- Documentation: usage examples, module matrix, required IAM permissions, supported topologies, and troubleshooting guidance.

Non-goals (alpha)
- Full multi-cloud parity (GCP/Azure) beyond design placeholders.
- Full on-prem networking automation; only ensure the module patterns don’t block on-prem packaging and can be referenced by on-prem guides.

Key stakeholders / teams
- Product: Vivek Kulkarni (Private Deployments) for requirements, alpha/beta gates.
- Infra: Irene Choi / Victor Alvarez / Nina Petrova for networking patterns and guardrails.
- Platform Control Plane: Ethan Park / Benji Okafor for installer/control-plane assumptions and integration points.
- Security: Marcus Lin / Kevin Osei for secure defaults, audit/logging expectations, and risk exceptions.
- DevEx/Docs: Elliot Price / Kira Thompson for public-facing and internal docs alignment.
- Solutions/PS: Markus Klein / Bruno Silva / Fatima Noor for customer implementation reality and feedback.

Timeline (typical)
- Phase 0 (1–2 weeks): requirements, topology decisions, module interfaces.
- Phase 1 (3–5 weeks): implement modules + CI validation + examples.
- Phase 2 (2–3 weeks): integration with redwood-private-installer, docs, and an alpha customer pilot.
- Exit criteria: reproducible deployments, security sign-off on defaults, documented upgrade path, and at least one successful pilot with measured deployment time reduction.

Constraints / risks
- Must be secure-by-default (least privilege IAM guidance, restricted ingress/egress patterns, flow logs and centralized logging options).
- Must minimize long-term support cost: clear supported topologies, explicit non-supported options, and strong validation.
- Customer environments vary (existing VPCs, shared networking, strict egress control, private endpoints only); module inputs must allow controlled flexibility without opening foot-guns.

Deliverables
- Terraform module set in `redwood-terraform` with semantic versioning.
- Example deployments in `redwood-examples`.
- Integration hooks and docs updates in `redwood-private-installer` and `redwood-docs`.
- Confluence reference architecture + runbooks + standards/ADRs.
- Linear execution plan and a small set of support/process artifacts for the pilot.

files.description: Published architecture overview for the alpha Terraform modules: target AWS topology, module composition, supported patterns, and how it maps to Redwood Private control plane/data plane requirements.
Step-by-step deployment guide using the reference modules: prerequisites, required AWS permissions, example tfvars, apply order, validation checks, and teardown guidance.
Day-2 ops guidance: updating module versions, handling drift, rotating NAT/EIP, changing subnet CIDRs (and what is unsupported), and common failure modes.
Policy for module versioning (SemVer), deprecation windows, upgrade notes requirements, rollback expectations, and how alpha → beta changes are managed.
IaC standards applied to this project: naming conventions, tagging schema, required variables/outputs, documentation blocks, and CI requirements for Terraform modules.
ADR selecting the default AWS VPC topology (subnet tiers, NAT strategy, endpoints, DNS approach), with alternatives considered (single NAT vs per-AZ, centralized egress, existing VPC integration).
ADR enumerating required/optional VPC endpoints for Private deployments and rationale (ECR, S3 gateway, CloudWatch Logs, STS, SSM), including security and operability implications.
Security review doc: secure defaults checklist (SG rules, NACL guidance, logging, encryption hooks), threat model notes, and any approved exceptions for alpha.
Guidance for enabling VPC Flow Logs and routing to customer-preferred sinks (CloudWatch/S3), retention recommendations, and how the Terraform modules expose configuration.
Docs plan for internal/external publication: page outline, required screenshots/snippets, cross-links to installer docs, and review checklist for GA readiness.
Runbook describing networking preflight checks used by the Private installer (DNS resolution, endpoint reachability, egress requirements) and how they align with the Terraform defaults.

Library page summarizing common enterprise constraints (existing VPC, shared transit gateway, no public egress, private-only endpoints) and how the alpha modules support or explicitly don’t support them.
Linear issue: Define module interfaces (inputs/outputs) for vpc-baseline, endpoints, and security-groups; include acceptance criteria and documentation requirements.
Linear issue: Implement AWS vpc-baseline module (VPC, subnets, RTs, IGW/NAT options) with tagging and validation.
Linear issue: Add VPC endpoints module (gateway + interface endpoints), private DNS toggle, and per-service conditional creation.
Linear issue: Implement security-groups baseline module for Redwood Private components; least-privilege defaults and configurable overrides.
Linear issue: CI for Terraform modules: fmt/validate, tflint, checkov, and integration plan tests; define pass/fail gates.
Linear issue: Create example deployment (single-account) and document required IAM policies for apply.
Linear issue: Integrate module outputs into redwood-private-installer networking config (subnet ids, endpoint ids, DNS) and add preflight validations.
Linear issue: Add migration/upgrade notes for alpha releases; define what changes are breaking vs non-breaking.
PM ticket: Alpha definition and exit criteria (pilot customer, success metrics like deployment time reduction, security sign-off, support readiness).
Linear issue: Add optional centralized egress pattern support (existing NAT/proxy) with explicit non-goals and guardrails.
PR: Initial scaffold for `modules/vpc-baseline` (variables, outputs, README template), repo linting, and pre-commit hooks.
PR: Implement subnet tiering (public/private/isolated) and route table associations; add validation for CIDR overlaps.
PR: NAT strategy options (single NAT vs per-AZ) with cost notes; include outputs used by installer.
PR: Add `modules/vpc-endpoints` (S3 gateway + ECR api/dkr + CloudWatch Logs); private DNS toggles and endpoint policy stubs.
PR: Add VPC Flow Logs support and log destination options (CloudWatch vs S3); default retention guidance in README.
PR: `modules/security-groups-baseline` for Redwood Private components; secure defaults and input validation for custom ports.
PR: Add terraform-docs generation and enforce README consistency in CI.
PR: Introduce checkov/tflint CI jobs; tune false positives and document suppression policy.
PR: Add integration test harness (ephemeral plan/apply) with matrix for regions and NAT mode; cache providers and handle retries.
PR: Wrapper module `modules/redwood-private-vpc` composing baseline + endpoints + SG; define stable outputs contract.
PR: Add “existing VPC” partial adoption mode (consume subnet IDs) and explicitly disable unsafe combinations; update docs.
PR: Tagging standard alignment (cost-center, env, owner, data-class) and migration notes for earlier tags.
PR: Add example tfvars for private-only endpoints/no public egress scenario; document prerequisites (private DNS resolver).
PR: Fix endpoint race condition in apply (depends_on) observed in integration tests; add regression test.
PR: Consume Terraform outputs for networking config; add preflight checks for endpoint reachability and DNS.
PR: Improve error messages for networking misconfigurations (missing ECR endpoints, S3 route); link to Confluence runbook.
PR: Add complete AWS example for alpha modules (minimal + “enterprise locked-down” variants) with README walkthrough.
PR: Draft docs site pages for Terraform modules alpha: module matrix, quickstart, troubleshooting, and versioning notes.
Thread coordinating default subnet tiering and NAT strategy; infra engineers discuss trade-offs and cost/support impact; links to ADR draft.
Thread debating required VPC endpoints for Private alpha; security and infra weigh in; decisions captured for ADR-0128.
Thread reviewing secure-by-default SG rules and whether to include NACL opinionation; includes checklist and requested changes.
Thread on installer integration details: which outputs are mandatory, how to validate DNS, and how to report actionable failures.
Thread between DevEx and engineers on terminology and doc placement (Confluence vs docs site), plus review assignments.
Thread triaging a CI integration test flake (endpoint creation eventual consistency); includes logs snippet and rerun results.
Thread announcing alpha module repo changes and requesting reviewers for PRs; includes checklist for reviewers.
Thread from Support flagging a pilot customer confusion about private-only egress; Solutions/Infra provide guidance and doc link.
Thread about a pilot install failure tied to missing STS endpoint; includes workaround and follow-up ticket creation.
Working draft of module inputs/outputs and naming conventions; unresolved questions; links to ENG-4821 and early diagrams.
Spreadsheet-style matrix of AWS endpoints (required/optional), why they’re needed, and which Private components depend on them.
Pilot plan deck: success metrics, timeline, responsibilities (PS/Infra/Security), and rollout + support escalation path.
Doc exploring CI strategy options (plan-only vs apply), cost control, and secrets handling for ephemeral AWS test accounts.
Choppy internal troubleshooting notes collected during development (common AWS errors, dependency ordering, DNS pitfalls).
Support ticket from a Private pilot: installer cannot pull images in locked-down VPC; investigation points to missing ECR/S3 endpoints; resolution and follow-up links.
Support ticket: terraform apply fails intermittently on endpoint association; includes logs, workaround (re-apply), and links to PR fixing depends_on.
HubSpot company record for an enterprise prospect evaluating Private VPC deployment; notes include strict egress control, required audit logging, and pilot next steps referencing Terraform modules.

Fireflies transcript: security review call touching audit logs, VPC flow logs, private connectivity, and secure defaults in the Terraform modules; next steps include sending security FAQ and architecture doc.
Email thread coordinating alpha gate criteria and pilot timeline across Product, Infra, and Security leadership; includes asks for sign-off and doc review.
Email thread: security sign-off discussion on secure defaults, flow logs, and exception handling; references the Confluence security review page and required changes.
Email thread with external pilot stakeholders summarizing install findings, required topology adjustments, and requested doc clarifications; includes attachment stubs (network diagram).
